sentences.pt: Ontem eu tive dor de cabeça o dia inteiro.
sentences.en: Yesterday I had a headache all day.
distractors: Yesterday I had a stomach ache all day.
Today I have a headache all day.
Yesterday I had a headache all morning.

sentences.pt: A médica me deu uma receita para três remédios.
sentences.en: The doctor gave me a prescription for three medicines.
distractors: The doctor gave me a prescription for two medicines.
The pharmacist gave me a prescription for three medicines.
The doctor showed me a prescription for three medicines.

sentences.pt: Marquei uma consulta com o dentista para a próxima terça.
sentences.en: I booked an appointment with the dentist for next Tuesday.
distractors: I booked an appointment with the doctor for next Tuesday.
I booked an appointment with the dentist for last Tuesday.
I booked an appointment with the dentist for next Thursday.

sentences.pt: Ela ficou na cama porque estava com febre.
sentences.en: She stayed in bed because she had a fever.
distractors: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
She stayed at home because she had a fever.
She stayed in bed because she had a cough.

sentences.pt: Você precisa beber muita água quando está com febre.

distractors: You need to drink a lot of tea when you have a fever.
You can drink a lot of water when you have a fever.

gloss.en: is; are (estar); estar com = to have (an illness)

sentences.pt: Hoje eu acordei às seis e meia da manhã.
sentences.en: Today I woke up at half past six in the morning.
distractors: Today I woke up at half past seven in the morning.
Today I woke up at six in the morning.
Today I went to bed at half past six in the morning.

gloss.en: half (seis e meia = half past six)

sentences.pt: Meu irmão vai à academia três vezes por semana.
sentences.en: My brother goes to the gym three times a week.
distractors: My sister goes to the gym three times a week.
My brother goes to the gym twice a week.
My brother goes to the pool three times a week.

sentences.pt: A farmácia abre no domingo de manhã?
sentences.en: Does the pharmacy open on Sunday morning?
distractors: Does the pharmacy open on Saturday morning?
Does the pharmacy open on Sunday evening?
Does the bakery open on Sunday morning?

sentences.pt: O farmacêutico me explicou como tomar esses comprimidos.
sentences.en: The pharmacist explained to me how to take these tablets.
distractors: The doctor explained to me how to take these tablets.
The pharmacist explained to me where to buy these tablets.
The pharmacist explained to me how to take this syrup.

sentences.pt: A gente não dormiu nada por causa do barulho.
sentences.en: We didn’t sleep at all because of the noise.
distractors: We didn’t sleep at all because of the heat.
They didn’t sleep at all because of the noise.
We didn’t eat at all because of the noise.

gloss.en: at all (não … nada = not at all)

sentences.pt: Quando eu era criança, ficava doente todo inverno.
sentences.en: When I was a child, I got ill every winter.
distractors: When I was a child, I got ill every summer.
When I was a child, I was never ill in winter.
When my brother was a child, he got ill every winter.

sentences.pt: Ela quebrou a perna durante um jogo de futebol.
sentences.en: She broke her leg during a football match.
distractors: She broke her arm during a football match.
He broke his leg during a football match.
She broke her leg during a tennis match.

sentences.pt: Ele está com tosse e dor de garganta há dois dias.
sentences.en: He has had a cough and a sore throat for two days.
distractors: He has had a cough and a sore throat for three days.
He has had a cough and a headache for two days.
She has had a cough and a sore throat for two days.

gloss.en: is; are (estar); estar com = to have (an illness)

sentences.pt: O médico disse para ele descansar até segunda-feira.
sentences.en: The doctor told him to rest until Monday.
distractors: The doctor told him to rest until Tuesday.
The doctor told her to rest until Monday.
The doctor told him to work until Monday.

gloss.en: to (dizer para = to tell someone to)

sentences.pt: Você vai tomar esse xarope de manhã e à noite durante uma semana.
sentences.en: You are going to take this syrup morning and evening for a week.
distractors: You are going to take this syrup morning and evening for two weeks.
You are going to take this syrup at lunchtime and in the evening for a week.
You are going to take this tablet morning and evening for a week.

sentences.pt: Eu nunca tive gripe, mas sempre pego resfriado.
sentences.en: I have never had flu, but I always catch colds.
distractors: I have often had flu, but I always catch colds.
I have never had flu, but I never catch colds.
I have never had flu, but my sister always catches colds.

sentences.pt: Você mediu a sua temperatura hoje de manhã?
sentences.en: Did you take your temperature this morning?
distractors: Did you take your temperature last night?
Did she take her temperature this morning?
Are you going to take your temperature this morning?

sentences.pt: O pronto-socorro fica aberto vinte e quatro horas por dia.
sentences.en: The emergency department is open twenty-four hours a day.
distractors: The emergency department is open twelve hours a day.
The pharmacy is open twenty-four hours a day.

sentences.pt: Minha irmã é enfermeira no hospital há cinco anos.
sentences.en: My sister has been a nurse at the hospital for five years.
distractors: My sister has been a nurse at the hospital for three years.
My sister has been a doctor at the hospital for five years.
My mother has been a nurse at the hospital for five years.

sentences.pt: Ele dormiu no sofá antes das dez horas.
sentences.en: He fell asleep on the sofa before ten o’clock.
distractors: He fell asleep on the sofa after ten o’clock.
She fell asleep on the sofa before ten o’clock.
He fell asleep in bed before ten o’clock.

sentences.pt: A gente andou duas horas e agora eu estou com dor nos pés.
sentences.en: We walked for two hours and now my feet hurt.
distractors: We walked for three hours and now my feet hurt.
We walked for two hours and now my legs hurt.
We ran for two hours and now my feet hurt.

sentences.pt: A consulta é no dia quinze de março, às duas da tarde.
sentences.en: The appointment is on the fifteenth of March, at two in the afternoon.
distractors: The appointment is on the fifteenth of May, at two in the afternoon.
The appointment is on the fifteenth of March, at three in the afternoon.
The appointment is on the fifth of March, at two in the afternoon.

sentences.pt: Você não deve comer muito açúcar se quer ter saúde.
sentences.en: You shouldn’t eat much sugar if you want to be healthy.
distractors: You shouldn’t eat much salt if you want to be healthy.
You should eat a lot of sugar if you want to be healthy.
You shouldn’t eat much sugar if you want to lose weight.

sentences.pt: Ela faz aula de ioga toda quinta à noite.
sentences.en: She does a yoga class every Thursday evening.
distractors: She does a yoga class every Tuesday evening.
She does a dance class every Thursday evening.
She does a yoga class every Thursday morning.

sentences.pt: Esperei o médico mais de uma hora na sala de espera.
sentences.en: I waited for the doctor for more than an hour in the waiting room.
distractors: I waited for the doctor for less than an hour in the waiting room.
I waited for the dentist for more than an hour in the waiting room.
I waited for the doctor for more than an hour in the car.

sentences.pt: Meus pais vão dormir cedo porque acordam às cinco horas.
sentences.en: My parents go to bed early because they wake up at five.
distractors: My parents go to bed early because they wake up at six.
My grandparents go to bed early because they wake up at five.
My parents go to bed late because they wake up at five.

gloss.en: to sleep (ir dormir = to go to bed)

sentences.pt: De manhã, eu corro meia hora no parque perto de casa.
sentences.en: In the morning I run for half an hour in the park near home.
distractors: In the evening I run for half an hour in the park near home.
In the morning I run for an hour in the park near home.
In the morning I walk for half an hour in the park near home.

sentences.pt: Ontem à noite tomei um comprimido e a dor passou.
sentences.en: Last night I took a tablet and the pain went away.
distractors: Yesterday morning I took a tablet and the pain went away.
Last night I took two tablets and the pain went away.
Last night I took a tablet and the pain got worse.

sentences.pt: Você está se sentindo melhor do que ontem?
sentences.en: Are you feeling better than yesterday?
distractors: Are you feeling worse than yesterday?
Is she feeling better than yesterday?
Are you feeling better than this morning?

sentences.pt: Não tem mais xarope na farmácia do bairro.
sentences.en: There is no more syrup at the local pharmacy.
distractors: There is still some syrup at the local pharmacy.
There are no more tablets at the local pharmacy.
There is no more syrup at the hospital pharmacy.

gloss.en: more (não tem mais = there is no more)

sentences.pt: Ela vai ligar para o médico amanhã de manhã.
sentences.en: She is going to call the doctor tomorrow morning.
distractors: She is going to call the doctor tomorrow afternoon.
I am going to call the doctor tomorrow morning.
She is going to call the dentist tomorrow morning.

sentences.pt: Ela passou uma semana no hospital depois da cirurgia.
sentences.en: She spent a week in hospital after the operation.
distractors: She spent two weeks in hospital after the operation.
She spent a week in hospital before the operation.
He spent a week in hospital after the operation.

sentences.pt: Meu avô anda devagar, mas sai de casa todos os dias.
sentences.en: My grandfather walks slowly, but he goes out every day.
distractors: My grandmother walks slowly, but she goes out every day.
My grandfather walks quickly, but he goes out every day.
My grandfather walks slowly, but he goes out every Sunday.

sentences.pt: Eu escovo os dentes antes de dormir.
sentences.en: I brush my teeth before I go to sleep.
distractors: I brush my teeth after I wake up.
She brushes her teeth before she goes to sleep.
I brush my hair before I go to sleep.

gloss.en: to sleep; to go to sleep

sentences.pt: Aos sábados, a gente anda de bicicleta na beira do rio.
sentences.en: On Saturdays we go cycling along the river.
distractors: On Sundays we go cycling along the river.
On Saturdays we go cycling along the beach.
On Saturdays we go running along the river.

gloss.en: rides (andar); andar de bicicleta = to cycle
bike; bicycle (andar de bicicleta = to cycle)
edge; bank (na beira do rio = along the river)

sentences.pt: Meu filho está com tosse desde ontem à noite e estou preocupada.
sentences.en: My son has had a cough since last night and I am worried.
distractors: My daughter has had a cough since last night and I am worried.
My son has had a cough since yesterday morning and I am worried.
My son has had a fever since last night and I am worried.

gloss.en: is; are (estar); estar com = to have (an illness)

sentences.pt: A aula de natação começa às nove e dura uma hora.
sentences.en: The swimming lesson starts at nine and lasts an hour.
distractors: The swimming lesson starts at ten and lasts an hour.
The swimming lesson starts at nine and lasts two hours.
The dance lesson starts at nine and lasts an hour.

sentences.pt: Cancelamos a consulta porque o carro quebrou.
sentences.en: We cancelled the appointment because the car broke down.
distractors: We cancelled the appointment because the bus broke down.
We cancelled the meeting because the car broke down.
I cancelled the appointment because the car broke down.

sentences.pt: Ela dorme mal quando toma café à noite.
sentences.en: She sleeps badly when she drinks coffee in the evening.
distractors: She sleeps badly when she drinks tea in the evening.
She sleeps well when she drinks coffee in the evening.
She sleeps badly when she drinks coffee in the afternoon.

sentences.pt: Você precisa parar de fumar para proteger os pulmões.
sentences.en: You need to stop smoking to protect your lungs.
distractors: You need to stop smoking to protect your heart.
You need to stop drinking to protect your lungs.
We need to stop smoking to protect our lungs.

gloss.en: to stop (parar de = to stop doing)

sentences.pt: O dentista tirou um dente meu na semana passada.
sentences.en: The dentist took out one of my teeth last week.
distractors: The dentist took out two of my teeth last week.
The dentist took out one of my teeth last month.
The dentist looked at one of my teeth last week.

sentences.pt: Quantas vezes por dia eu tenho que tomar esse remédio?
sentences.en: How many times a day do I have to take this medicine?
distractors: How many times a week do I have to take this medicine?
How many tablets a day do I have to take?
How many times a day do I have to take this syrup?

gloss.en: have (ter); tenho que = I have to

sentences.pt: Depois da cirurgia, ele não conseguia levantar o braço direito.
sentences.en: After the operation he couldn’t lift his right arm.
distractors: After the operation he couldn’t lift his left arm.
After the operation he couldn’t lift his right leg.
Before the operation he couldn’t lift his right arm.

sentences.pt: Hoje de manhã, a sala de espera estava cheia de pacientes cansados.
sentences.en: This morning the waiting room was full of tired patients.
distractors: This afternoon the waiting room was full of tired patients.
This morning the waiting room was full of tired children.
This morning the waiting room was full of angry patients.

sentences.pt: Na próxima semana, vou marcar uma consulta com o fisioterapeuta.
sentences.en: Next week I am going to book an appointment with the physiotherapist.
distractors: This week I am going to book an appointment with the physiotherapist.
Next week I am going to book an appointment with the dentist.
Next week I am going to cancel an appointment with the physiotherapist.

sentences.pt: Elas se inscreveram numa aula de dança às quartas.

distractors: They signed up for a dance class on Thursdays.
They signed up for a swimming class on Wednesdays.
He signed up for a dance class on Wednesdays.

sentences.pt: Meu médico novo é mais simpático do que o antigo, mas fala rápido.
sentences.en: My new doctor is nicer than the old one, but he speaks fast.
distractors: My new doctor is nicer than the old one, but he speaks slowly.
My new doctor is less nice than the old one, but he speaks fast.
My new dentist is nicer than the old one, but he speaks fast.

sentences.pt: Tem algum médico que fala inglês neste bairro?
sentences.en: Is there a doctor who speaks English in this neighbourhood?
distractors: Is there a doctor who speaks French in this neighbourhood?
Is there a nurse who speaks English in this neighbourhood?
Is there a doctor who speaks English in this hospital?

sentences.pt: Você não pode mexer o pulso durante três dias, tá bom?

distractors: You can’t move your wrist for four days, okay?
You can’t move your ankle for three days, okay?

sentences.pt: A que horas o consultório fecha na sexta?

distractors: What time does the surgery open on Friday?
What time does the surgery close on Saturday?
What time does the pharmacy close on Friday?

lines.speaker: A médica
lines.pt: Boa tarde, Juliana. O que você está sentindo?
lines.en: Good afternoon, Juliana. How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: Juliana
lines.pt: Estou com dor de garganta há quatro dias e tusso muito à noite.
lines.en: I have had a sore throat for four days and I cough a lot at night.

lines.speaker: A médica
lines.pt: Você teve febre?
lines.en: Have you had a fever?

lines.speaker: Juliana
lines.pt: Hoje de manhã, eu estava com trinta e oito graus.
lines.en: This morning my temperature was thirty-eight degrees.

lines.speaker: A médica
lines.pt: Não é nada grave. Descanse e beba bastante água.
lines.en: It is nothing serious. Rest and drink plenty of water.

lines.speaker: Juliana
lines.pt: Posso ir trabalhar amanhã?
lines.en: Can I go to work tomorrow?

lines.speaker: A médica
lines.pt: É melhor ficar em casa dois dias. Depois, você pode voltar ao trabalho.
lines.en: It is better to stay at home for two days. After that you can go back to work.

questions.question: How long has Juliana had a sore throat?
questions.explanation: She says: “Estou com dor de garganta há quatro dias”.

questions.question: What was her temperature this morning?
questions.explanation: “Hoje de manhã, eu estava com trinta e oito graus.”

questions.question: What does the doctor tell her to do?
choices: Rest and drink plenty of water
questions.explanation: “Descanse e beba bastante água.”

questions.question: When can she go back to work?
questions.explanation: “É melhor ficar em casa dois dias.” Only after that can she go back.

gloss.en: I am (estar); estou com dor = I have a pain
nothing (não é nada grave = it is nothing serious)

lines.speaker: O farmacêutico
lines.pt: Boa tarde. O senhor tem receita?
lines.en: Good afternoon. Do you have a prescription?

lines.speaker: Rodrigo
lines.pt: Tenho, sim. É para a minha filha, ela está com gripe.
lines.en: Yes, I do. It is for my daughter, she has flu.

lines.speaker: O farmacêutico
lines.pt: Certo. Este xarope, três vezes por dia, depois das refeições.
lines.en: Right. This syrup, three times a day, after meals.

lines.speaker: Rodrigo
lines.pt: Durante quantos dias?
lines.en: For how many days?

lines.speaker: O farmacêutico
lines.pt: Durante cinco dias. Com febre alta, é melhor ligar para o médico.
lines.en: For five days. If she has a high fever, it is better to call the doctor.

lines.speaker: Rodrigo
lines.pt: Muito obrigado. Quanto é?
lines.en: Thank you very much. How much is it?

lines.speaker: O farmacêutico
lines.pt: São vinte e dois reais.
lines.en: That is twenty-two reais.

questions.question: Who is the medicine for?
questions.explanation: “É para a minha filha, ela está com gripe.”

questions.question: How should the syrup be taken?
choices: Three times a day, after meals
Three times a day, before meals
Once a day, in the evening
questions.explanation: “Este xarope, três vezes por dia, depois das refeições.”

questions.question: How long should the treatment last?
questions.explanation: “Durante cinco dias.”

questions.question: How much does Rodrigo pay?
questions.explanation: “São vinte e dois reais.”

gloss.en: is (estar); está com gripe = has flu

lines.speaker: A secretária
lines.pt: Consultório da doutora Lima, bom dia.
lines.en: Doctor Lima’s surgery, good morning.

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Bom dia. Eu queria marcar uma consulta, por favor.
lines.en: Good morning. I would like to book an appointment, please.

lines.speaker: A secretária
lines.pt: Pode ser na terça, dia dezessete, às onze horas?
lines.en: Is Tuesday the seventeenth at eleven o’clock all right?

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Eu trabalho na terça de manhã. Vocês têm algum horário à tarde?
lines.en: I work on Tuesday mornings. Do you have a time in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: A secretária
lines.pt: Então quinta, dia dezenove, às seis e meia da tarde.
lines.en: Then Thursday the nineteenth, at half past six in the evening.

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Perfeito. A consulta é para o meu filho, ele tem oito anos.
lines.en: Perfect. The appointment is for my son, he is eight years old.

questions.question: Why can’t Patrícia take the first appointment?
questions.explanation: “Eu trabalho na terça de manhã.”

questions.question: When is the appointment in the end?
choices: Tuesday the nineteenth at half past six
Thursday the nineteenth at half past six
questions.explanation: “Então quinta, dia dezenove, às seis e meia da tarde.”

questions.question: Who is the appointment for?
questions.explanation: “A consulta é para o meu filho”

questions.question: How old is the patient?
questions.explanation: “ele tem oito anos”. The other numbers are the date and the time.

gloss.en: doctor (a woman, used with a name)
can it be; is it all right (poder ser)
half (seis e meia = half past six)
is (ter); tem oito anos = is eight years old

lines.pt: Oi, Bruno, hoje eu não vou ao escritório.
lines.en: Hi Bruno, I am not coming to the office today.

lines.pt: Peguei a gripe do meu filho e estou com febre desde ontem.
lines.en: I caught my son’s flu and I have had a fever since yesterday.

lines.pt: Vou ficar na cama e à noite vou marcar uma consulta.
lines.en: I am going to stay in bed and this evening I am going to book an appointment.

lines.pt: Você pode cancelar a reunião das duas e avisar a Carla?
lines.en: Can you cancel the two o’clock meeting and let Carla know?

lines.pt: Espero voltar na segunda. Muito obrigado!
lines.en: I hope to come back on Monday. Thank you very much!

questions.question: Why is the writer staying at home?
choices: He caught the flu from his son
His son needs him at home
questions.explanation: “Peguei a gripe do meu filho e estou com febre desde ontem.”

questions.question: What does he ask Bruno to do?
choices: Move the meeting to the evening
Cancel the two o’clock meeting and tell Carla
questions.explanation: “Você pode cancelar a reunião das duas e avisar a Carla?”

questions.question: When is he going to book the appointment?
questions.explanation: “à noite vou marcar uma consulta”

questions.question: When does he hope to come back to work?
questions.explanation: “Espero voltar na segunda.”

gloss.en: am (estar); estou com febre = I have a fever
two (a reunião das duas = the two o’clock meeting)

lines.pt: O sono é tão importante quanto o esporte para a saúde.
lines.en: Sleep is as important as sport for your health.

lines.pt: Um adulto precisa dormir entre sete e oito horas por noite.
lines.en: An adult needs to sleep between seven and eight hours a night.

lines.pt: À noite, evite café e telas antes de deitar.
lines.en: In the evening, avoid coffee and screens before going to bed.

lines.pt: Se você acorda muitas vezes durante a noite, fale com o seu médico.
lines.en: If you often wake up during the night, talk to your doctor.

questions.question: What does the text compare sleep with?
questions.explanation: “O sono é tão importante quanto o esporte para a saúde.”

questions.question: How long should an adult sleep?
questions.explanation: “Um adulto precisa dormir entre sete e oito horas por noite.”

questions.question: What should you avoid in the evening?
questions.explanation: “evite café e telas antes de deitar”

questions.question: What should you do if you often wake up at night?
questions.explanation: “fale com o seu médico”

gloss.en: to sleep; to go to sleep

lines.speaker: Larissa
lines.pt: Você quer correr comigo no sábado de manhã?
lines.en: Do you want to go running with me on Saturday morning?

lines.speaker: Felipe
lines.pt: Não posso, eu jogo futebol aos sábados.
lines.en: I can’t, I play football on Saturdays.

lines.speaker: Larissa
lines.pt: E no domingo? A gente pode correr uma hora no parque.
lines.en: What about Sunday? We can run for an hour in the park.

lines.speaker: Felipe
lines.pt: Tá bom, mas não muito cedo. Às nove horas, pode ser?
lines.en: Okay, but not too early. Is nine o’clock all right?

lines.speaker: Larissa
lines.pt: Perfeito. Da última vez, fiquei com dor nos joelhos durante dois dias.
lines.en: Perfect. Last time my knees hurt for two days.

lines.speaker: Felipe
lines.pt: Você precisa caminhar cinco minutos antes de correr.
lines.en: You need to walk for five minutes before running.

questions.question: Why does Felipe say no to Saturday?
questions.explanation: “Não posso, eu jogo futebol aos sábados.”

questions.question: When do they agree to run?
questions.explanation: “E no domingo?” and then “Às nove horas, pode ser?”

questions.question: What happened to Larissa last time?
choices: She was ill for two days
Her knees hurt for two days
questions.explanation: “Da última vez, fiquei com dor nos joelhos durante dois dias.”

questions.question: What does Felipe advise before running?
questions.explanation: “Você precisa caminhar cinco minutos antes de correr.”

gloss.en: is that all right?; that works (poder ser)
I was; I ended up (ficar); fiquei com dor = it hurt

lines.pt: Esta semana, eu dormi muito mal.
lines.en: This week I slept very badly.

lines.pt: Na segunda e na terça, trabalhei até meia-noite num relatório.
lines.en: On Monday and Tuesday I worked until midnight on a report.

lines.pt: Na quarta de manhã, eu estava tão cansada que esqueci a consulta com o dentista.
lines.en: On Wednesday morning I was so tired that I forgot my dentist appointment.

lines.pt: À noite, fui para a cama às nove horas e dormi doze horas.
lines.en: In the evening I went to bed at nine o’clock and slept for twelve hours.

lines.pt: Desde quinta, estou me sentindo muito melhor.
lines.en: Since Thursday I have been feeling much better.

questions.question: What kept her up on Monday and Tuesday?
questions.explanation: “Na segunda e na terça, trabalhei até meia-noite num relatório.”

questions.question: What did she forget on Wednesday morning?
questions.explanation: “esqueci a consulta com o dentista”

questions.question: How long did she sleep on Wednesday night?
questions.explanation: “dormi doze horas”. Nine o’clock is when she went to bed.

questions.question: How has she felt since Thursday?
questions.explanation: “Desde quinta, estou me sentindo muito melhor.”

lines.speaker: A enfermeira
lines.pt: O que aconteceu?
lines.en: What happened?

lines.speaker: Gustavo
lines.pt: Eu caí da bicicleta hoje de manhã e o meu tornozelo está muito inchado.
lines.en: I fell off my bike this morning and my ankle is very swollen.

lines.speaker: A enfermeira
lines.pt: Você consegue andar?
lines.en: Can you walk?

lines.speaker: Gustavo
lines.pt: Um pouco, mas dói muito quando coloco o pé no chão.
lines.en: A little, but it hurts a lot when I put my foot on the floor.

lines.speaker: A enfermeira
lines.pt: Vamos fazer uma radiografia. Pode sentar aqui, o médico chega em dez minutos.
lines.en: We are going to do an X-ray. You can sit here, the doctor will be here in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Gustavo
lines.pt: Obrigado. Eu tenho um jogo de futebol no domingo.
lines.en: Thank you. I have a football match on Sunday.

lines.speaker: A enfermeira
lines.pt: Esqueça o jogo, você precisa descansar.
lines.en: Forget the match, you need to rest.

questions.question: How did Gustavo get hurt?
choices: He was hurt in a football match
questions.explanation: “Eu caí da bicicleta hoje de manhã”

questions.question: What does he say about walking?
choices: He can walk without any pain
He can walk a little, but it hurts when he puts his foot down
He can only walk with help
questions.explanation: “Um pouco, mas dói muito quando coloco o pé no chão.”

questions.question: What happens next?
choices: He goes home with a bandage
An X-ray, and the doctor arrives in ten minutes
questions.explanation: “Vamos fazer uma radiografia.” and “o médico chega em dez minutos”

questions.question: What does the nurse say about Sunday’s match?
choices: He can play if his ankle is better
He must forget it and rest
He can watch but not play
questions.explanation: “Esqueça o jogo, você precisa descansar.”

lines.pt: A farmácia do centro vai ficar fechada do dia doze ao dia quinze de agosto.
lines.en: The town centre pharmacy will be closed from the twelfth to the fifteenth of August.

lines.pt: Durante esses quatro dias, a farmácia da rodoviária vai ficar aberta.
lines.en: During those four days, the bus station pharmacy will stay open.

lines.pt: Ela abre todos os dias das oito às vinte horas, menos no domingo.
lines.en: It opens every day from eight in the morning to eight in the evening, except on Sunday.

lines.pt: Em caso de emergência à noite, ligue para o número cento e noventa e dois.
lines.en: In an emergency at night, call one hundred and ninety-two.

questions.question: When is the town centre pharmacy closed?
choices: From the twelfth to the fifteenth of August
From the fifteenth to the twentieth of August
From the second to the fifth of August
questions.explanation: “do dia doze ao dia quinze de agosto”

questions.question: Which pharmacy stays open during those days?
choices: The one in the town centre
The one at the bus station
questions.explanation: “a farmácia da rodoviária vai ficar aberta”

questions.question: On which day is that pharmacy closed?
questions.explanation: “menos no domingo”

questions.question: What should you do in an emergency at night?
choices: Go to the bus station pharmacy
Wait until eight in the morning
questions.explanation: “ligue para o número cento e noventa e dois”

gloss.en: twenty (às vinte horas = at eight in the evening)
